card.name: Scattered words before dose or condition terms
card.fires_on: No single word type fits. It fires on small linking words, spaces and word pieces in mixed settings, often just before a dose, a condition or a medical term.

modes.label: Linking words before a condition or dose
modes.description: Small words such as for, in or a comma that come right before a condition name or dosing phrase.
